svg.text: Choosing a Statistical Model in Biostatistics
Start at the top — identify your outcome type, then follow the arrows down.

g.text: e.g. blood pressure, weight, lab values
e.g. time to death, time to relapse
Before choosing a model, check these assumptions:
1. 📊 Normality — Q-Q plot, Shapiro-Wilk test, histogram of residuals
2. 📊 Homogeneity of variance — Levene\u2019s test, F-test, residual plot
3. 📊 Sample size — small n (e.g. <30)? Consider non-parametric alternatives
